boards.school_name: State University of New York at Cortland
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Memorial Library study environments, ranging from collaborative seating to designated quiet and reservable spaces.

cards.entity_name: Memorial Library First-Floor Open Seating Study Areas
cards.title: First-Floor Open Seating
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · noise permitted
cards.notes: Set up in the first-floor open seating areas when conversation and active campus movement will not disrupt your work.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor option for work that can tolerate ambient noise.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland lists open seating study areas on Memorial Library’s first floor and states that noise is allowed in most first-floor areas.
cards.source_title: Library Map Text Descriptions | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: Located in Memorial Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Memorial Library Second-Floor Open Seating Study Areas
cards.title: Second-Floor Open Seating
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · moderate-noise floor
cards.notes: Use the second-floor open seating areas for reading, laptop work, or short work sessions in a moderate-noise setting.
cards.short_summary: Open seating on a floor designated as typically moderate noise.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland lists open seating study areas on Memorial Library’s second floor and describes that floor as typically a moderate-noise area.
cards.source_title: Library Map Text Descriptions | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: Located in Memorial Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Memorial Library Third-Floor Wing A Open Seating Study Areas
cards.title: Third-Floor Wing A Seating
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · low-noise floor
cards.notes: Head to third-floor Wing A when you want open seating in a lower-noise library environment for sustained individual work.
cards.short_summary: Open seating on Memorial Library’s low-noise third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland lists open seating study areas in Memorial Library’s third-floor Wing A and describes the third floor as typically low noise.
cards.source_title: Library Map Text Descriptions | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: Located in Memorial Library, third-floor Wing A; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Fourth-Floor Quiet Area
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · Wing A
cards.notes: Choose the fourth-floor quiet area for focused reading or writing, and keep conversations and calls for another library zone.
cards.short_summary: The library’s specifically designated quiet floor area.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland identifies Memorial Library’s fourth-floor Wing A as a quiet area.
cards.source_title: Library Map Text Descriptions | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: Fourth-floor Wing A of Memorial Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Fourth-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · individual rooms
cards.notes: Look for an individual room when you need a contained workspace; these fourth-floor rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.short_summary: Individual study rooms in the library’s designated quiet area.
cards.evidence_claim: Memorial Library reports 34 fourth-floor study rooms; they are for individual study, first-come first-served, and require neither reservation nor key for SUNY Cortland students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: 4th Floor Study Rooms | SUNY Cortland Library
cards.access_notes: Available first-come, first-served to SUNY Cortland students, staff, and faculty; no reservation or key is required.

cards.title: Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · reservation and key checkout
cards.notes: Reserve a group room ahead, then use the key checkout process when your project needs a dedicated shared workspace.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for pairs and larger study groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Memorial Library has three group study rooms for two people and six for groups of four or more; current students reserve them and sign out a key.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Group Study Room | SUNY Cortland Library
cards.access_notes: Available for checkout to current students; a reservation and key checkout are required.

cards.title: Bookmark Cafe Study Area
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the study area reached from the Bookmark Cafe entrance when you want a first-floor library setup near the café.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor study area adjacent to the Bookmark Cafe entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland’s library map states that the Bookmark Cafe entrance leads to a study area; the cafe is on the library’s first floor.
cards.access_notes: Enter through Memorial Library’s Bookmark Cafe entrance; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Computer Applications Lab
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Bring work that benefits from a computer-lab setting and confirm whether the room is open rather than assigned to instruction.
cards.short_summary: A named computer-lab resource on Memorial Library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland lists the Computer Applications Lab on the second floor of Memorial Library.
cards.source_title: Library Map Text Descriptions | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: Located on Memorial Library’s second floor; verify availability and current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Phylis Duke Fralick ’58 and Fredric Fralick ’59 Teaching Materials Center
cards.title: Teaching Materials Center
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the Teaching Materials Center when course work calls for teacher-education collections, materials, or a library-based worktable.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor center with curriculum-focused collections and services.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland identifies the Teaching Materials Center on Memorial Library’s first floor and says it provides collections, instruction, outreach, and research services for teacher education students and faculty.
cards.access_notes: Located on Memorial Library’s first floor; its services are described for SUNY Cortland teacher education students and faculty.

cards.title: Inspiration Station
cards.subtitle: Teaching Materials Center · Memorial Library
cards.notes: Plan a small-group working session in Inspiration Station when you need a separate room for collaborative academic preparation.
cards.short_summary: A separate small-group collaboration room within the Teaching Materials Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland describes Inspiration Station as a separate room for small-group collaborations, located downstairs in the Teaching Materials Center.
cards.source_title: Library offers crafting space for recreation and education | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: Located in the Teaching Materials Center in Memorial Library; confirm access arrangements with the library before planning a session.
